annotations.title: Room paint, drywall, flooring and trim estimator

description: Room paint, drywall, flooring and trim estimator — Material takeoff for a room from its length, width and height: gross and net wall area (doors 21 sqft, windows 15 sqft deducted), ceiling and floor area (sqft and sqm), paint gallons per coat with buy quantities in gallons/quarts/5-gal buckets (walls, optional ceiling and primer), drywall sheets with 10% waste plus joint compound, tape and screw estimates, flooring square feet and boxes with pattern waste, underlayment rolls, baseboard linear feet and 8/16-ft pieces, casing sets. Params: length and width (ft). Optional: height (default 8), doors (default 1), windows (default 1), coats (default 2), coverage (sqft/gal, default 350), paint_ceiling, primer, drywall_ceiling (default yes), sheet 4x8|4x10|4x12|4x14|4x16, box (sqft per flooring box, default 20), pattern straight|diagonal|herringbone, floor_waste (percent), rooms (identical rooms), unit ft|m or suffixes like 4m. Offline rules of thumb. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: eng_room
